title: Dual-Evolving Reinforcement Learning for Automated Reward Design
abstract: arXiv:2512.13399v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Crafting effective reward signals remains a central challenge in reinforcement learning (RL) for complex reasoning. Existing methods for automated reward optimization search with a fixed proposer which never learns from its costly trials. We present Dual-Evolving Reinforcement Learning (DERL), a dual-training framework for autonomous discovery of reward structures. An outer-loop proposer composes a reward from task primitives, and an inner policy trains with this reward. The proposer itself learns by policy gradient from the validation performance of the inner policy. Thus, DERL utilizes past-trial feedback to shape its reward-proposal distribution, an empirical meta-gradient of task success. We validate DERL on embodied (ALFWorld), scientific (ScienceWorld), and mathematical (GSM8K, MATH) reasoning. On multi-turn agent benchmarks, DERL outperforms strong baselines, significantly on out-of-distribution tasks. In mathematics, DE

translated_title: 面向自动化奖励设计的双重进化强化学习
translated_abstract: 构建有效的奖励信号仍然是强化学习（RL）在复杂推理任务中的核心挑战。现有的自动化奖励优化方法使用固定的提议者进行搜索，而该提议者从不从其代价高昂的试验中学习。我们提出了双重进化强化学习（Dual-Evolving Reinforcement Learning, DERL），这是一个用于自主发现奖励结构的双重训练框架。外循环的提议者从任务基元中组合奖励，内层策略则使用该奖励进行训练。提议者本身通过策略梯度从内层策略的验证性能中学习。因此，DERL能够利用过去的试验反馈来塑造其奖励提议分布，这构成了任务成功的经验性元梯度。我们在具身推理（ALFWorld）、科学推理（ScienceWorld）和数学推理（GSM8K、MATH）上验证了DERL。在多轮智能体基准测试中，DERL超越了强大的基线方法，在分布外任务上的优势尤为显著。在数学领域，DE……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出双重进化强化学习框架DERL，通过让外循环奖励提议者从内层策略的验证表现中学习元梯度，实现奖励结构的自主发现与持续优化，在具身、科学和数学推理任务上显著超越基线，尤其在分布外任务上表现突出。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces DERL, a dual-training framework where an outer-loop reward proposer learns from inner policy validation performance via policy gradients, enabling autonomous discovery of reward structures that outperform strong baselines on embodied, scientific, and mathematical reasoning tasks, with especially significant gains on out-of-distribution tasks.
